accepted_submission.accepted_at: submission timestamp of an AC submission, not judge completion
accepted_submission.difficulty: same units as solve; may be null
accepted_submission.title: problem title

account.complete: 1 only after an entire visible history scan
account.last_success: last successful request time or null

identity: account_id + submission_id; solves deduplicate account_id + problem_id

solve.difficulty: Luogu 0..8 or CF rating; null if unknown
solve.solved_at: earliest observed accepted submission time; null for undated snapshots
solve.title: problem title
